source: Make me an driving game with models from roblox store and a cool city to drive aruond

image_prompt.text: Vehicle-width streets and avenues threading the whole city, wide enough for car meshes to turn
A large shared open area on the edge of the city that the whole server draws from
a dense city of blocks and buildings worth driving around in - downtown towers, commercial streets, outer neighbourhoods

notes: Vehicle Sim rather than Racing because there is no lap and no finish line - the prompt asks for free driving around a city.
Using models from the Roblox store is an asset-sourcing instruction with no field in the handoff.

open_questions.ask: How big a city - a few blocks to cruise, or a full open-world map?
Is there anything to do while driving - deliveries, races, police chases - or is cruising the whole game?
Modern real-world city, or something more stylized?

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the city be?
Free cruising, or is there an objective?
Which store models specifically, or just any suitable ones?

answers.ask: How big a city - a few blocks to cruise, or a full open-world map?
answers.answer: A few connected city blocks is enough for a small, polished cruising map.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do while driving - deliveries, races, police chases - or is cruising the whole game?
answers.answer: Cruising around the city is the whole game; no extra activities are needed.

answers.ask: Modern real-world city, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Use a modern real-world city style with roads, buildings, streetlights, and traffic-style details.
